basic_info.description: Experience the charm of this light-filled, top-floor, south-facing condo, discreetly tucked away behind a majestic tree amidst the homes of Potrero Hill. Welcome to your dream residence in this captivating 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo within a charming 2-unit building. The inviting living room greets you with new flooring, expansive windows, a skylight, vaulted ceilings, and exposed timber details. A spiral staircase ascends to a loft area, offering breathtaking views of Twin Peaks to the west.    The dining area connects to the well-appointed kitchen, featuring granite countertops, a built-in microwave, stainless steel appliances, and a spacious pantry. As you stroll down the hallway, you'll discover the in-unit washer/dryer, a full bathroom, and the second bedroom. At the home's rear, the primary ensuite bedroom boasts vaulted ceilings, skylights, a full en-suite bathroom, and ample closet space, overlooking your private deck that descends to a generous shared backyard.    Outdoor enthusiasts will adore the shared yard, complete with a hot tub, barbecue, and dining area, ideal for savoring morning coffee or unwinding under the starlit sky. Top-floor homes like this are a rare find don't miss the opportunity to make it yours!
